facts.text: The research found no case in any industry of a new automatic braking function progressing from first representative hardware to accepted validation in about four months.
facts.quote: The research found no case, in any industry, of a new automatic braking function going from first representative hardware to accepted validation in about four months

facts.text: Every documented reduction in physical testing rested on years of earlier investment in simulation and statistics, a deliberately narrow operating envelope, or both.
facts.quote: Every documented reduction in physical testing rested on years of earlier investment in simulation and statistics, on a deliberately narrow operating envelope, or on both.

facts.text: Building a credible virtual validation capability in the German PEGASUS project took 42 months and 17 partners.
facts.quote: Building a credible virtual validation capability took 42 months and 17 partners in the German PEGASUS project

facts.text: Building a credible virtual validation capability took years in every documented case other than PEGASUS as well.
facts.quote: and years in every other documented case (Chapter 2).

facts.text: The four-month validation window cannot be compressed, but most validation work can be moved ahead of that window.
facts.quote: The four months cannot be compressed, but most of the work can be moved in front of them.

facts.text: An automatic-braking validation program starting in October 2026 can realistically have an operating-domain definition and scenario catalog built on ISO 21815 and the EMESRT scenarios working by mid-2027.
facts.quote: A program that starts in October 2026 can realistically have the following working by mid-2027: an operating-domain definition and scenario catalog built on ISO 21815 and the EMESRT scenarios;

facts.text: An automatic-braking validation program starting in October 2026 can realistically have a data-recording and replay pipeline running on the existing warning-system fleet by mid-2027.

facts.text: An automatic-braking validation program starting in October 2026 can realistically have software-in-the-loop simulation with partly validated sensor models working by mid-2027.

facts.text: An automatic-braking validation program starting in October 2026 can realistically have one hardware-in-the-loop bench working by mid-2027.
An automatic-braking validation program starting in October 2026 can realistically have a parameterized machine and brake model working by mid-2027.

facts.text: An automatic-braking validation program starting in October 2026 can realistically have a proving-ground test kit working by mid-2027.
An automatic-braking validation program starting in October 2026 can realistically have a credibility dossier that an assessor has already seen by mid-2027.

facts.text: With preparatory validation work completed before prototype arrival, the four-month validation window becomes a confirmation and calibration campaign rather than the first iteration of a simulation method.
facts.quote: The four months then become a confirmation and calibration campaign, not the first iteration of a simulation method (Chapters 6, 10, 13).

facts.text: The recommended automatic-braking validation strategy is to build the credibility envelope before the prototype arrives.
facts.quote: build the credibility envelope before the prototype arrives

facts.text: Virtual evidence should substitute for physical evidence only inside the established credibility envelope.
facts.quote: substitute virtual for physical evidence only inside that envelope

facts.text: The recommended release strategy is to launch within a restricted operating domain, following the precedent of Volvo CE, Komatsu and Caterpillar.
facts.quote: launch a restricted operating domain the way Volvo CE, Komatsu and Caterpillar did

facts.text: Physical testing should be retained where simulation is weak.
facts.quote: keep physical testing where the simulation is weak (Chapters 1, 2, 10, 13).
